needs.reason: The coordinates exist only when Gradle runs the script: the artifact names come from a Groovy loop over a list, the version from the project property jacksonVersion, and jackson-dataformat-yaml from an if on the property withYaml. Both properties can be overridden from outside the files (-P, ORG_GRADLE_PROJECT_*, ~/.gradle/gradle.properties).

traps: No dependency coordinate is written out: a text scan of build.gradle finds the template com.fasterxml.jackson.core:jackson-${module}:${jacksonVersion}, not three artifacts.
jacksonVersion is a Gradle project property from gradle.properties, visible as a plain variable in the Groovy script.

jackson-dataformat-yaml is present only because gradle.properties sets withYaml=true; with -PwithYaml=false the build has three dependencies, and src/main/java/com/example/computed/Config.java no longer compiles.
No Java version and no Gradle version are declared: toolchains is empty and the build uses the JDK that runs Gradle.
build.gradle writes the placeholder ${jacksonVersion}; declared is its value 2.18.1 from gradle.properties#jacksonVersion, and resolved stays null because no lockfile or BOM fixes it.
